risks.risk: Engine may not actually be healthy internally (compression, head gasket, crank/bearings) even if it started briefly.
risks.proof: Video clip of cold start + 5–10 minutes idle under load (if possible) and a compression test sheet (all cylinders).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working / worst case (needs overhaul or unknown condition).

risks.risk: Exact engine model may be different from what the buyer needs (wrong fit/compatibility).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the engine ID plate/serial number and any casting/model markings (multiple angles).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unidentified engine assembly (lowest generic value).

risks.risk: Completeness risk: missing parts or accessories not visible in the single photo.
risks.proof: Full inventory photos of all major components (starter, alternator, AC compressor, power steering pump, sensors, hoses/connectors) and underside for leaks.

risks.risk: “Never opened” may be false; prior repairs can’t be confirmed from the current image.
risks.proof: Close-up of cylinder head area (gasket/seal condition), timing cover area, and any machining/fastener wear; plus photos of bolt heads.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as previously opened/unknown repair history.

risks.risk: Guarantee claim may be unenforceable or not documented.
risks.proof: Written guarantee terms + proof of purchase/shipping documents and serial match to the item.

proof_requests: Send a short video of cold start and steady idle (no knock, no heavy smoke) and ideally a brief rev test.
Send compression test results (all cylinders) or a mechanic’s test report with readings.
Send clear close-up photos of the engine ID plate/serial number and any model/casting codes.
Send full completeness photos (all accessories and connectors) and underside for leaks.
Send written guarantee terms and any origin/shipping documents (or at least serial match evidence).
response.reason: The seller’s text claim of testing is not supported by any new photo/video or test results. Without readable identifiers and verifiable test evidence, a reliable worst-case price still can’t be set.
